articles.title: CMBS Loan Backed by Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort Sent to Special Servicing
articles.narrative: A $302 million CMBS loan secured by the Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort & Spa has been transferred to special servicing after the sponsor failed to make its final maturity payment. The 1,230-key luxury resort, which also includes nearly 95,000 square feet of retail, was reportedly in negotiations for a sale when the default occurred. The property has faced cash flow challenges, with its 2023 revenue significantly below the 2021 underwriting projections.

data_points.property_name: Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort & Spa
data_points.notable_features: Two-tower luxury resort with approximately 94,961 square feet of retail space on site.
data_points.project_notes: The $302 million loan is the remaining debt on a $450 million loan used to refinance the property in 2021. Property was purchased in September 2016 for $780 million.

articles.title: Investment Firm Garnett Station Partners Expands to 35K SF at 450 Park Avenue
articles.narrative: Garnett Station Partners, a private equity investment firm, has expanded its office space at 450 Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, signing an 11.5-year lease for an additional 10,392 square feet. This expansion brings their total footprint in the building to 35,355 square feet. The firm has been a tenant in the SL Green Realty-owned building since 2023.

data_points.address: 450 Park Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.project_notes: Garnett Station Partners previously occupied 24,963 square feet in the building. SL Green Realty acquired the building in 2022 for $445 million.

articles.title: Related Urban Secures $129M Financing for Downtown Miami Project
articles.narrative: Related Urban Development Group has secured $129 million in financing for Gallery Lummus Parc, a 257-unit affordable housing development in Downtown Miami. The project, located on a 0.7-acre site next to Lummus Park and near a major transit station, will feature 27 stories of residential units and a five-level parking garage. Over 80% of the apartments will be income-restricted, catering to a wide range of income levels, including workforce and market-rate units. Construction is slated to begin this month and is expected to be completed in two years.

data_points.address: 101 Northwest North River Drive, Miami, FL
data_points.notable_features: Transit-oriented development located in Miami-Dade County's Rapid Transit Zone, with over 80% of units having rents tied to household income.
data_points.project_notes: Additional financing includes $27.1M from Low-Income Housing Tax Credit, $12.75M from Florida Housing Finance Corporation, $5M from Miami-Dade County, $3M from City of Miami, and $6.4M in Opportunity Zone investment from an affiliate of Related Group.

articles.title: Union Investment Sells Meatpacking District Retail Condo for $27M
articles.narrative: Union Investment Real Estate, a German investment manager, has sold a 15,000-square-foot retail condominium unit at 415 West 13th Street in Manhattan's Meatpacking District for $26.5 million. The buyer was West Gotham Re Projects Corporation. Union Investment had originally acquired the condo in 2012 for $18 million.

data_points.address: 415 West 13th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Retail condo unit at the base of a mixed-use building.
data_points.project_notes: Union Investment previously acquired the condo for $18 million in 2012.

articles.title: BridgeCity Lends $84M on Midtown East Office-to-Resi Conversion
articles.narrative: CSC Real Estate secured an $83.5 million acquisition and construction loan from BridgeCity Capital to convert a 20-story office building at 136 East 57th Street in Midtown East into 136 luxury apartments. The project aims to capitalize on the property's prime location and the growing trend of office-to-residential conversions in Manhattan. CSC Real Estate had previously acquired the building in March for $10 million.

data_points.address: 136 East 57th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located at the corner of East 57th Street and Lexington Avenue, across from another office-to-residential conversion project.
data_points.project_notes: The 20-story building was acquired by CSC Real Estate for $10 million in March 2026 from Cerco Funding. The property was renovated in 1987.

articles.title: ICON Real Estate Negotiates $4.1M Sale of Apartment Building in Bayonne, New Jersey
articles.narrative: ICON Real Estate Advisors has facilitated the $4.1 million sale of a 25-unit apartment building in Bayonne, New Jersey. The property, consisting exclusively of one-bedroom units, was sold by a local family to an undisclosed buyer.

articles.title: HarbourVest Partners Signs 19,752 SF Office Lease in Midtown Manhattan
articles.narrative: HarbourVest Partners, a Boston-based private equity firm, has secured a 10-year office lease for 19,752 square feet on the 49th floor of 9 West 57th Street in Midtown Manhattan. This transaction reflects continued demand for prime office space in the city.

data_points.address: 9 West 57th Street, New York City, NY

articles.title: Max Benjamin Partners Arranges $74.8M in Construction Financing for Townhome Property in Flagstaff, Arizona
articles.narrative: Max Benjamin Partners has secured $74.8 million in nonrecourse construction financing for Red Oak Development's Pine Haven, an 83-unit townhome community in Flagstaff, Arizona. The development will feature three-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhomes with two-car garages and a wellness amenity center. Situated on 13.8 acres within the Coconino National Forest, the project emphasizes preservation, with half the property remaining as forest and dark-sky compliant lighting throughout. First unit sales are anticipated in late 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Located within Coconino National Forest with half the property preserved as forest, featuring a wellness amenity center and dark-sky compliant lighting.
data_points.project_notes: First unit sales are expected to commence in late 2027.

articles.title: National City Investment Group Breaks Ground on 120-Unit Apartment Community in California
articles.narrative: The National City Investment Group has commenced construction on Market View, a 120-unit workforce apartment community located at 303 Highland Ave. in National City, CA. The development will transform a former parking lot into three residential buildings offering studio, one-, and two-bedroom layouts, with completion anticipated in early 2028. The project emphasizes community and wellness, featuring shared outdoor spaces, a rooftop deck, coworking facilities, and a wellness center.

data_points.notable_features: Adjacent to Manolo Farmers Market, features shared rooftop deck, coworking area, and wellness center with outdoor yoga deck.

articles.title: Colliers Brokers Sale of Two-Property Multifamily Portfolio in Fallbrook, California for $37M
articles.narrative: Colliers has brokered the sale of a two-property multifamily portfolio in Fallbrook, California, for a combined total of approximately $37 million. The portfolio included Amberwood Apartments, a 133-unit community, and Rosewood Apartments, a 73-unit community. The transactions involved two separate sellers, Amber Creek Associates LTD and Rosewood Associates LTD.

articles.title: Adolfson & Peterson completes renovation and 106-bed expansion at Cross Creek Hospital in Austin
articles.narrative: Adolfson & Peterson Construction has completed a significant renovation and expansion project at Cross Creek Hospital in Austin, Texas. The project added 106 beds, bringing the hospital's total capacity to 196 licensed beds, and included a 96,580-square-foot two-story building addition. This expansion, undertaken by a joint venture between Ascension Seton and Acadia Healthcare, aims to address the growing demand for behavioral health services in the region.

data_points.notable_features: Expansion included therapy and exam rooms, administration rooms, noisy and quiet areas, and an outdoor patient courtyard. Renovations covered the dining hall, kitchen, administrative space, and outpatient area offices.
data_points.project_notes: The project was a phased construction, increasing the hospital's total licensed bed count to 196. New parking areas and a water quality system upgrade were also part of the project.

articles.title: Cross Street unveils branding for nine-story boutique apartment community under construction in Chicago’s River North
articles.narrative: Cross Street, ZSD Corp., and Third Coast Real Estate have unveiled the branding and official website for 310 West, a nine-story boutique apartment community currently under construction in Chicago's River North neighborhood. The 149-unit development, which recently topped off, will offer a mix of studio to three-bedroom rental apartments, including 11 two-story duplex residences with private patios, along with approximately 3,800 square feet of ground-floor retail. Pre-leasing is slated to begin in February 2027, with initial move-ins expected in spring 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Features 11 two-story duplex residences with private patios and a publicly accessible lobby coffee bar. Amenities include a rooftop lounge, fitness center, coworking space, and multiple outdoor terraces.
data_points.project_notes: Replaces a surface parking lot. Pre-leasing to begin in February 2027.

articles.title: Six considerations for spec suites in an evolving office market
articles.narrative: This article argues that speculative, or "spec," suites are becoming the preferred option for office tenants due to their speed and value, shifting away from traditional tenant allowances. The author contends that modern businesses prioritize smarter use of space and nimble decision-making, which spec suites facilitate by offering move-in ready, furnished, and technologically equipped spaces with predetermined costs and occupancy dates. Landlords are advised to focus on creating high-quality, hospitality-focused spaces that balance collaboration and focus, rather than maximizing density. The article emphasizes that spec suites demonstrate landlord investment and stability, appealing to tenants seeking long-term partnerships and a high-performing office environment that can compete with remote work.

articles.title: Beyond square footage: Designing offices around how people work
articles.narrative: Hiffman National, a commercial real estate firm, recently redesigned its headquarters in Oakbrook Terrace, Illinois, expanding its footprint to 33,000 square feet across the first and fourth floors. The project focused on creating a contemporary, client-facing environment on the first floor with enhanced collaboration spaces, private conversation areas, and flexible work settings, reflecting a broader industry shift towards designing offices around how people work rather than just maximizing density. The firm aimed to balance individual 'me space' with collaborative 'we space' to support diverse work styles and foster a sense of belonging for its team members.

data_points.notable_features: New design includes one- and two-person phone rooms, larger conference rooms, informal work settings like booth seating and lounges, and a retractable glass wall for flexible event space.
data_points.project_notes: The first-floor space was previously occupied by a bank and sat vacant for several years; it was returned to shell condition and completely rebuilt.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield adds three to Chicago office leasing and capital markets teams
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield has expanded its Chicago office leasing and capital markets teams with three strategic hires, including two Executive Managing Directors and a Transaction Manager. These additions are expected to enhance the firm's capabilities in serving investors and owners in the suburban office market, particularly in lease-up strategies, office capital markets, and investment sales. The new team members bring extensive experience in commercial real estate, including a strong background in leasing, investment sales, acquisitions, and asset management, which will bolster the firm's ability to help clients achieve their real estate objectives.

articles.title: SoHo Office and Retail Property Refinanced Through ACORE Capital
articles.narrative: A joint venture between Aurora Capital, Allied Partners, and A&H Acquisitions secured $216 million in bridge financing from ACORE Capital to refinance 568 Broadway, a trophy mixed-use asset in Manhattan's SoHo neighborhood. The property's prime corner location, strong retail tenancy, and recently upgraded infrastructure contribute to its appeal. SoHo's limited supply of office and retail space is expected to support future rent growth and occupancy durability, according to the brokers involved.

data_points.notable_features: Premier corner positioning with Broadway frontage, recently upgraded infrastructure, and flexible office product.

articles.market_intelligence: SoHo remains one of Manhattan’s most supply-constrained office and retail submarkets, with limited large-block inventory and minimal new competitive supply.

articles.title: Culver City Mixed-Use Secures $133M Bank OZK Loan
articles.narrative: Lincoln Property Company and McCourt Partners have secured $132.7 million in construction financing from Bank OZK for ElevenOneEleven, a new mixed-use development in Culver City. The project will feature 344 residences, including a significant portion of affordable units, alongside retail space and publicly accessible outdoor areas. This financing is a crucial step in advancing the development, reflecting the partners' confidence in the project's contribution to the Culver City community.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 52 affordable units and 17,520 square feet of publicly accessible outdoor space.

articles.title: New York People and Company News, Week of Oct. 16, 2026
articles.narrative: This article profiles Paul Bubny, Senior Content Director for Connect Commercial Real Estate, highlighting his extensive career in commercial real estate journalism. It details his responsibilities, including overseeing daily operations, reporting on market trends and transactions, and developing long-form content. The profile also notes his previous role as Managing Editor for Real Estate Forum and GlobeSt.com.

articles.title: The Ride, Like Most Business, Was About Navigating the Journey
articles.narrative: This article is an editorial piece reflecting on the author's cross-country bicycle ride and drawing parallels between the challenges of the journey and those encountered in business. The author, a managing director at Walker & Dunlop, undertook the 3,200-mile ride to raise money and awareness for No Kid Hungry. He argues that both long bike rides and business ventures require adaptability, the ability to change plans when facts shift, and the wisdom to select the right tools or strategies for specific conditions. He concludes that focusing on small, manageable segments of a larger goal is crucial for sustained progress and success, especially when facing difficult circumstances.

articles.title: Consumer Goods Companies Scrutinize CRE Portfolios As Technology Spending Lags
articles.narrative: A recent JLL report highlights that consumer goods companies are intensely scrutinizing their real estate portfolios, driven by supply chain disruptions and evolving consumer spending patterns. The survey of 48 industry leaders indicates a strong focus on supply chain examination, significantly higher than the all-industry average. Despite this heightened focus on real estate strategy, technology investment in CRE for consumer goods firms lags behind other sectors, suggesting a potential gap in leveraging data for optimal decision-making. The report also notes workforce downsizing and an expectation for increased office use rates among these companies, underscoring a dynamic approach to portfolio management.

articles.title: TruAmerica Buys Dunwoody Apartments At Discount: The Atlanta Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: TruAmerica Multifamily has acquired a 322-unit apartment community in Dunwoody, GA, from Clark Ventures. The transaction was part of a larger trend of institutional investors seeking value in the current market, with TruAmerica noting the property was purchased at a significant discount to replacement cost. The acquisition expands TruAmerica's footprint in the Atlanta metropolitan area, a market they view as having strong long-term fundamentals.

data_points.notable_features: Acquired at a significant discount to replacement cost.

articles.title: Owner Of Nearly 1,900-Unit Chicago Property Hit With Investor Lawsuit
articles.narrative: Antheus Capital is facing a lawsuit from an investor alleging breach of contract related to a nearly 1,900-unit multifamily property in Chicago. The legal action centers on claims that Antheus Capital violated terms of an agreement with one of its financial partners.

articles.title: Brookfield Veteran Departs To Become Pretium's Global Real Estate Lead
articles.narrative: Christopher Reilly, a veteran from Brookfield, has joined Pretium to lead its global real estate debt and equity business. This move signifies a significant leadership change in the real estate investment sector.

articles.title: Lenders Accuse Nord Group Entities Of Pocketing Rents, Faking Insurance As Multifamily Empire Crumbles
articles.narrative: Lenders are accusing Nord Group affiliates of diverting rental income and fabricating insurance documents as the firm's extensive 4,000-unit multifamily portfolio faces foreclosure and bankruptcy proceedings. A federal judge has issued a stern directive for a Nord Group affiliate to vacate one of the properties, highlighting the severity of the financial distress and alleged misconduct.

articles.title: Hospital Construction Costs Are Climbing. Atlanta's Healthcare Systems Keep Building
articles.narrative: The increasing demand for outpatient care, driven by the aging U.S. population, is prompting healthcare systems to expand their facilities. This trend is evident in Atlanta, where healthcare providers are continuing to build new facilities despite rising construction costs.
